tagline: Find and merge duplicate records on any Odoo model using fuzzy matching rules
problem: Duplicate contacts, products, employees, and vendors pollute CRM, inventory, and HR data. Manual cleanup is slow and error-prone.
solution: Smart Duplicate Finder is a generic framework: define rules per model, run weighted fuzzy scans, review scored pairs, then merge or ignore duplicates with a guided wizard.
benefits: Works on any Odoo model, including custom apps
Weighted exact, fuzzy, and phone digit matching
Ignore pairs to keep recurring scans clean
Native partner merge plus safe archive for other models
Scheduled scans for proactive data quality

features.title: Rule-based framework
features.text: Create duplicate rules for res.partner, product.template, hr.employee, or any model.

features.title: Weighted scoring
features.text: Combine field weights with exact, fuzzy, and phone digit match modes.

features.title: Scan batches
features.text: Run on-demand or scheduled scans with match threshold and record limits.

features.title: Merge wizard
features.text: Merge partners with Odoo native merge. Archive duplicates on other models.

seo_keywords: Odoo 20 duplicate finder, fuzzy matching, merge contacts, deduplicate products, data quality, ARMORA
